content_sections.heading: NPCIL CA/CMA Intern Recruitment 2026 Quick Summary
content_sections.text: Who is recruiting: Nuclear Power Corporation of India Limited (NPCIL) Post: CA/CMA Intern (practical training in Finance and Accounts) Total vacancies: 51 Who can apply: Indian nationals who have passed Inter CA or Inter CMA, aged 18 to 56 years as on 26/10/2026 Application start date: 06/10/2026 Last date to apply: 26/10/2026 (up to 17:00 hrs) Application mode: Online only Job location: NPCIL Headquarters Mumbai and Units in Maharashtra, Rajasthan, Uttar Pradesh, Gujarat, Tamil Nadu, Karnataka and Haryana Application fee: No fee Stipend: Rs 20,000 per month

content_sections.heading: NPCIL CA/CMA Intern Vacancy 2026
content_sections.text: NPCIL has notified a total of 51 intern vacancies across its Headquarters and Units. The notification states that Government of India orders on reservation will be followed, and that the vacancy count may change depending on the extension or completion of existing interns. The notes printed with the vacancy table are given below. ST* and OBC* include backlog vacancies. PwBD *: One vacancy was reserved horizontally for category (a), which could not be filled in 2023 and 2024, and could not be filled in 2025 either through interchange under identified PwBD. This year it is reserved for (a) LV, (b) D, HH, (c) OA, OL, OAL, BL, BA, CP, LC, Dw, AAV, SD/SI without any associated neurological/limb dysfunction, SD/SI with associated limb dysfunction of OA/OL/OAL/BL/BA, (d) ASD (M, MoD), SLD, MI, (e) MD. PwBD #: LV - Low Vision. PwBD **: D - Deaf, HH - Hard of Hearing. The number of interns may change depending on the extension or completion of existing interns undergoing training. In such cases, candidate selection may be kept on hold or cancelled, or an offer may be issued after the previous batch completes its training, subject to the maximum number of vacancies at the particular site. The full forms of the site abbreviations (TAPS, RAPS, NAPS, KAPS, MAPS, KGS, GHAVP, KKNPP) are not given in the notification.

content_sections.heading: NPCIL CA/CMA Intern Important Dates
content_sections.text: The online application window is open from 06/10/2026 to 26/10/2026. The application form is available on the official website from 10:00 hrs on 06/10/2026 till 17:00 hrs on 26/10/2026. Applications received after the due date will be summarily rejected.

content_sections.heading: NPCIL CA/CMA Intern Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: NPCIL CA/CMA Intern eligibility covers nationality, qualification and age. Candidates should read the criteria carefully and confirm they meet every condition before applying, because candidature can be cancelled at any stage if a candidate is found ineligible. Only Indian nationals are eligible to apply. The candidate must have passed the Inter CA or Inter CMA examination. The candidate must be within the prescribed age limit as on 26/10/2026. Applicants without final marks will not be considered and need not apply.

content_sections.heading: NPCIL CA/CMA Intern Qualification
content_sections.text: The internship is offered to candidates who have passed Inter CA or Inter CMA and are to be trained in the field of Finance and Accounts. The notification states that eligibility for practical training at NPCIL Units and HQ will be as per the terms and conditions provided by the respective institutions. The notification also states that these prescribed qualifications are the minimum and that possessing them does not entitle a candidate to be called for the interview. Candidates must enter the exact percentage of marks in the qualification section of the form. Marks must not be rounded off, so 49.99% should not be entered as 50%.

rows.qualification: Passed Inter CA or Inter CMA, subject to the terms and conditions of the respective institutions

content_sections.heading: NPCIL CA/CMA Intern Age Limit
content_sections.text: The age limit is calculated as on 26/10/2026. The minimum age is 18 years and the maximum age is 56 years, as printed in the notification. Age relaxation details are not specified in the notification.

content_sections.heading: NPCIL CA/CMA Intern Application Fee
content_sections.text: There is no fee for applying for the NPCIL CA/CMA Intern internship. Candidates of all categories can apply online without paying any application fee.

content_sections.heading: NPCIL CA/CMA Intern Stipend (Salary)
content_sections.text: Selected interns receive a monthly stipend rather than a salary, because the notification treats them as trainees. The stipend is Rs 20,000 per month. An additional Rs 5,000 per month is paid where accommodation is not available at the NPCIL Unit or HQ. Accommodation: A suitable accommodation (single room or bare minimum accommodation) is provided at Units on payment of the normal license fee. If accommodation is not available at Units and HQ, Rs 5,000 per month is given in lieu of accommodation. Transport and medical: Free site transportation subject to availability, and free OPD and first aid facility only. Leave: 1 day of paid leave per month, which is 12 days for one year. For extensions, leave is pro-rata for the extended period. Stipend is deducted proportionately for absence other than admissible leave. Working hours: 8 hours a day in general shift including a 1 hour lunch break, 5 days a week. Injury compensation: NPCIL is liable to pay compensation for personal injury caused by accident arising out of and during training, as per the Employees' Compensation Act, 1923. Status: Interns are treated as trainees and labour-related laws applicable to employees do not apply to them. NPCIL is not obliged to offer employment after the training period.

content_sections.heading: NPCIL CA/CMA Intern Selection Process
content_sections.text: The selection is based on Inter CA/Inter CMA marks followed by a virtual personal interview. Screening is done on the aggregate of marks, so only screened-in candidates are informed by e-mail about the further selection process. Screening: Candidates are shortlisted for the personal interview in the ratio of 1:5, based on the aggregate marks obtained in the Inter CA/Inter CMA examination. Personal Interview: Selection of interns is by personal interview, which candidates can attend in virtual mode at the respective Unit/Region. Certificate Verification and Medical Examination: Candidates are engaged after qualifying the standard medical examination and after satisfactory verification of certificates. Police and Character Verification: Interns are engaged based on the police verification certificate issued by District Police authorities, and a character/conduct certificate must be submitted from the concerned institution. Candidates with higher marks in the Inter CA/Inter CMA examination are placed higher in the merit list. If both interview marks and Inter CA/Inter CMA marks are equal, the candidate senior in age is ranked higher. If interview marks, Inter CA/Inter CMA marks and age are all the same, the merit list is prepared in alphabetical order of the name (first name, middle name and surname). Candidates who wish to apply for more than one location must mention their preference. They are shortlisted on CA/CMA marks only and are interviewed at one of the sites of their choice.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for NPCIL CA/CMA Intern Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: NPCIL accepts applications only through its online registration system. Hard copy, handwritten or typed applications delivered in person or by any other means will not be entertained, and candidates should not send any documents or applications to NPCIL. The online application form is available at www.npcilcareers.co.in from 06/10/2026 (10:00 hrs) to 26/10/2026 (17:00 hrs). The online process has four steps: registration, activation, filling details with photo and signature upload, and printing the application form. Visit the official website www.npcilcareers.co.in . Click on Apply, then Online Registration, at the top or left corner of the page. Enter basic details such as name, date of birth, category, email and mobile number. An activation link is sent to the email. Click the activation link received by email to activate the account. Log in with the Login ID and password. Fill in the stages in order: Educational Qualification, Personal Details, Upload Photo and Signature, and Submit Application. Use the Save and Proceed to Next Step option at each stage. Check the draft of all entered details at the Submit Application stage. Details can be modified until submission, but no changes are allowed after the application is submitted. Submit the application to receive the application number, which is also sent by email. View and print the online application form. Candidates should note their Login ID and password, as these are needed to check the application status through the Applicant's Login link. The uploaded photograph is printed on the call letter, and only the applicant whose photograph is printed on the call letter is allowed to appear for the online interview, certificate verification and medical examination. An application without a valid photograph and signature will not be accepted. The category (SC/ST/OBC (NCL)/EWS/PwBD) filled in the form cannot be changed later. If a candidate submits multiple applications, only the latest application is considered.

content_sections.heading: Documents Required for Interview, Certificate Verification and Medical Examination
content_sections.text: Shortlisted candidates should keep their Aadhaar Card and online application form ready when reporting for the online interview, and must carry a clearly printed e-Call Letter. Original documents and self-attested copies, along with a duly signed hard copy of the online application, are required at certificate verification and medical examination. Candidates who do not produce the required documents will not be allowed to appear for the medical examination. SC/ST/OBC (Non Creamy Layer): Caste/category certificate in the format prescribed by the Government of India. OBC (NCL) certificates must be issued on or after 01/04/2026, and OBC applicants called for the interview must give an undertaking at the time of reporting that they belong to the OBC (Non Creamy Layer) category. EWS: Income and Asset Certificate in the prescribed format from a competent authority, valid for the year 2026-27. PwBD: Disability certificate issued by an authority prescribed in the Rights of Persons with Disabilities Rules, 2017. Certificates in other languages: A self-certified translated copy in English or Hindi if a certificate is issued in any other language. Police verification certificate issued by District Police authorities and a character/conduct certificate from the concerned institution. The prescribed format for the EWS certificate can be downloaded from www.npcilcareers.co.in, and the standard formats enclosed with the notification are for SC/ST/OBC (NCL)/EWS/PwBD and the OBC undertaking.

content_sections.heading: Other Important Conditions
content_sections.text: NPCIL reserves the right to fill all intern vacancies, alter the number of vacancies, or cancel, suspend, postpone or alter the whole recruitment process, and to change the recruitment criteria at any stage without prior notice. Issue of an e-Call Letter for the virtual interview gives no right or claim to the internship. Final selection is based on merit and subject to all eligibility conditions and Government of India guidelines on reservation and concessions. No request for change of the virtual interview date or time will be entertained. A candidate who provides wrong information, submits false documents, suppresses relevant information, uses unfair means, is found guilty of impersonation or uploads a non-human or irrelevant photograph is liable to be disqualified, prosecuted and debarred, and the application or appointment is cancelled. Records of candidates who are not selected are not preserved beyond 6 months from the date of publication of the select list. In case of any ambiguity arising from versions other than English, the English version prevails. Legal jurisdiction for any dispute is Mumbai. NPCIL strives to have a workforce which reflects gender balance and women applicants are encouraged to apply.

faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting the NPCIL CA/CMA Intern Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The recruitment process is conducted by the Nuclear Power Corporation of India Limited (NPCIL) to hire qualified candidates for internship positions across various operational units.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available under NPCIL CA/CMA Intern Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: A total of 51 vacancies have been announced for the CA/CMA Intern position under the advertisement number NPCIL/CACMA/2026/04 for eligible candidates meeting the criteria.

faq.question: Q3. What is the essential qualification required for NPCIL CA/CMA Intern?
faq.answer: Candidates must have passed the Intermediate examination of CA or CMA in the relevant field of Finance and Accounts to be considered eligible for applying.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit to apply for NPCIL CA/CMA Intern Posts?
faq.answer: The age limit for applicants is set between a minimum of 18 years and a maximum of 56 years as per the official recruitment notification guidelines.

faq.question: Q5. What is the monthly salary or stipend offered for this internship?
faq.answer: Selected candidates will receive a monthly stipend of Rs. 20,000/- along with an additional amount of Rs. 5,000/- p.m. if institutional accommodation is not available.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for NPCIL CA/CMA Intern Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee required for candidates belonging to any category applying for the CA/CMA Intern positions through the online portal.

faq.question: Q7. What are the opening and closing dates for online application submission?
faq.answer: The online application process begins on 6 October 2026 and concludes on 26 October 2026. Candidates must complete submissions before the deadline.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection procedure for NPCIL CA/CMA Intern?
faq.answer: The selection process involves screening of applications based on aggregate marks, shortlisting in a 1:5 ratio, virtual personal interviews, medical exams, and police verification.

faq.question: Q9. How can candidates apply for the NPCIL CA/CMA Intern Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Eligible candidates can apply online by visiting the official careers website at www.npcilcareers.co.in, registering, filling out details, and submitting the form before the last date.

faq.answer: The official notification PDF can be accessed and downloaded directly through the important links section provided within this recruitment article or via the official website.
